description: Khuzait-inspired teal floor-length fitted court gown over a cream underdress, with a low square neckline, elbow sleeves, gold geometric edging and a narrow front opening. A decorated woven belt with round metal clasps and tasseled ends secures the waist. A pale wrap with teal-gold patterned borders rests on the arms; drop earrings, rings and patterned teal-brown flats complete the outfit.
